Read the case study  ↗» abre «Case Study: DMG MORI — Multilevel Post-Merger Integration, International Supply Chain Control & Mission-Critical Industrial Delivery (2013 – 2016)».
Desde «JubAp.US», el enlace «Distributed American Innovation account» abre «Distributed Operational Intelligence Across the Americas».

Desde «JubAp.US», el enlace «Chicontepec Megaproject SPV structuring, supplier integration and compliance within a complex energy ecosystem. Read the case study  ↗» abre «Case Study: Chicontepec Megaproject».
Desde «JubAp.US», el enlace «Explore our Case Studies» abre «Case Studies».
The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.
Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.
For a complementary reading, see [Supplier evidence and audit-reactive mapping](https://jubap.us/case-study-weatherford-multi-level-information-management-for-oilfield-supplier-management/).
For a complementary reading, see [Field intelligence in the Texas–Mérida corridor](https://jubap.us/field-intelligence-in-chicontepec-and-the-texas-merida-corridor/).
For a complementary reading, see [The Texas–Mérida operational continuum](https://jubap.us/field-intelligence-in-chicontepec-and-the-texas-merida-corridor/).

For a complementary reading, see [Texas-to-Mexico industrial knowledge transfer](https://jubap.us/case-study-texas-to-mexico-oilfield-services-transformation-knowledge-transfer-industrialization-and-compliance/).
